# Federal Reserve Board

> The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System provides U.S. central bank policy, supervision, research, data, and public information.

The Federal Reserve Board website is the primary source for Board governance, monetary policy decisions, banking supervision and regulation, economic research, statistical releases, publications, news, and public resources about the Federal Reserve System.

## About the Federal Reserve
- [About the Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed.htm): Overview of the Federal Reserve Board, mission, responsibilities, and institutional information.
- [Structure of the Federal Reserve System](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/fedexplained/who-we-are.htm): Explains the Board, Reserve Banks, FOMC, and overall system structure.
- [The Fed Explained](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/the-fed-explained.htm): Educational guide to the Federal Reserve’s purpose, functions, and tools.
- [Federal Reserve Banks](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/federal-reserve-system.htm): Describes the twelve Reserve Banks and their roles in the system.
- [Federal Reserve Act](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/fract.htm): Information and resources related to the Federal Reserve Act.
- [Currency](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/currency.htm): Overview of the Board’s role in U.S. currency issuance and circulation.
- [Economic Education](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/educational-tools/default.htm): Educational tools and classroom resources about the Federal Reserve and economy.

## Leadership, Governance, and Meetings
- [Board Members](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/bios/board/default.htm): Biographies and profiles of current members of the Board of Governors.
- [Advisory Councils](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/advisorydefault.htm): Information on advisory councils that provide input to the Board.
- [Federal Reserve Bank and Branch Directors](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/directors/about.htm): Details on Reserve Bank and branch directors across the system.
- [Board Meetings](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/boardmeetings/meetingdates.htm): Schedules and information for Board of Governors meetings.
- [Board Votes](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/boardvotes.htm): Records of votes by members of the Board of Governors.
- [Ethics & Values](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/ethics-values.htm): Ethics framework, values, and conduct expectations for the Board.
- [Holidays Observed - K.8](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm): Federal Reserve holiday schedule and related K.8 release information.

## Monetary Policy
- [Monetary Policy](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy.htm): Central hub for policy tools, implementation, reports, and committee materials.
- [FOMC](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomc.htm): Federal Open Market Committee information, meeting materials, and policy statements.
- [FOMC Calendars and Information](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm): Meeting calendars, minutes, transcripts, and historical FOMC materials.
- [Monetary Policy Principles and Practice](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/monetary-policy-principles-and-practice.htm): Explains the framework and implementation of U.S. monetary policy.
- [Policy Rules Database](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/policy-rules-database.htm): Database of monetary policy rules used for research and comparison.
- [Reserve Requirements](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/reservereq.htm): Information on reserve requirement policy and related implementation details.
- [Discount Window](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/discountrate.htm): Discount rate and discount window information for depository institutions.

## Supervision and Regulation
- [Supervision & Regulation](https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg.htm): Main portal for banking supervision, regulation, and policy guidance.
- [Laws and Regulations](https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/legalinterpretations.htm): Access to legal interpretations, regulations, and supervisory materials.
- [Reporting Forms](https://www.federalreserve.gov/apps/reportforms/default.aspx): Federal Reserve reporting forms, instructions, and filing resources.
- [Applications and Legal Developments](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases.htm): Includes announcements on enforcement, applications, and regulatory actions.
- [Community Reinvestment Act](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/cra_about.htm): CRA-related information, guidance, and community development resources.
- [Stress Tests and Capital Planning](https://www.federalreserve.gov/supervisionreg/stress-tests-capital-planning.htm): Supervisory stress test and capital planning information for large banks.
- [Enforcement Actions](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases.htm): Press releases and announcements covering supervisory enforcement actions.

## Data, Statistics, and Economic Information
- [Data](https://www.federalreserve.gov/data.htm): Central access point for statistical releases, data downloads, and data tools.
- [Statistical Releases and Historical Data](https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases.htm): Official statistical releases and historical Federal Reserve data series.
- [Economic Research & Data](https://www.federalreserve.gov/econres.htm): Research, working papers, data, and analysis from Board economists.
- [Beige Book](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/publications/beige-book-default.htm): Summary of current economic conditions across Federal Reserve districts.
- [Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization - G.17](https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g17/current/default.htm): Monthly release on industrial production and capacity utilization.
- [Consumer Credit - G.19](https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g19/current/default.htm): Monthly statistics on consumer credit outstanding.
- [Financial Accounts of the United States - Z.1](https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/z1/current/default.htm): Comprehensive financial accounts for sectors of the U.S. economy.

## Publications and Reports
- [Publications](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications.htm): Directory of reports, manuals, brochures, and recurring Federal Reserve publications.
- [Monetary Policy Report](https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/mpr_default.htm): Semiannual report to Congress on monetary policy and the economy.
- [Financial Stability Report](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/financial-stability-report.htm): Assessment of vulnerabilities and risks to U.S. financial stability.
- [Annual Report](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/annual-report.htm): Annual overview of Board activities, operations, and financial statements.
- [Fed Financial Statements](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/fed-financial-statements.htm): Audited financial statements and related financial reporting for the Board.
- [Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/2024-economic-well-being-of-us-households-in-2023.htm): Annual survey report on household finances and economic conditions.
- [Consumer Compliance Outlook](https://www.federalreserve.gov/publications/consumer-compliance-outlook.htm): Publication covering consumer compliance supervision and regulatory developments.

## News and Communications
- [News & Events](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents.htm): Hub for press releases, speeches, testimony, and event information.
- [Press Releases](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases.htm): Official announcements from the Board, including policy and regulatory actions.
- [Speeches](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/speeches.htm): Speeches by Board members and senior Federal Reserve officials.
- [Testimony](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/testimony.htm): Congressional testimony and prepared remarks by Board officials.
- [Calendar](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/calendar.htm): Schedule of Board events, meetings, and statistical release dates.
- [Recent Postings](https://www.federalreserve.gov/recentpostings.htm): Chronological list of newly posted content across the site.
- [RSS Feeds](https://www.federalreserve.gov/feeds/feeds.htm): RSS subscriptions for news, speeches, testimony, and publications.

## Consumers and Communities
- [Consumers & Communities](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities.htm): Resources on consumer affairs, community development, and household finance.
- [Consumer Help](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/consumer-resources.htm): Consumer resources and information about financial products and complaints.
- [Community Development](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/community-development.htm): Research and initiatives supporting community and economic development.
- [Mortgage and Foreclosure Resources](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/mortgage.htm): Consumer information related to mortgages and foreclosure issues.
- [Credit and Credit Reports](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/credit-reports-and-scores.htm): Educational information on credit reports, scores, and borrowing.
- [Community Reinvestment Act](https://www.federalreserve.gov/consumerscommunities/cra_about.htm): CRA background, performance evaluations, and related community resources.

## Careers, Contact, and Public Access
- [Careers](https://www.federalreserve.gov/careers.htm): Employment opportunities, benefits, internships, and working at the Board.
- [Contact](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/contact-us-topics.htm): Contact information by topic for public and institutional inquiries.
- [Requesting Information (FOIA)](https://www.federalreserve.gov/foia/about_foia.htm): Freedom of Information Act guidance and request procedures.
- [FAQs](https://www.federalreserve.gov/faqs.htm): Frequently asked questions about the Federal Reserve and Board operations.
- [Do Business with the Board](https://www.federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/procurement/tips.htm): Procurement guidance for vendors seeking to do business with the Board.
- [Accessibility](https://www.federalreserve.gov/accessibility.htm): Accessibility statement and information for using the website.
- [A to Z](https://www.federalreserve.gov/azindex.htm): Alphabetical index of Federal Reserve Board website content.
